data.title: Unit 3: The plant world
Seeds and germination
data.heading: Seed dispersal
data.text: The process by which plants scatter their seeds is called seed dispersal.
Some seeds have hooks or pointed spikes on them.
Some plants produce their seeds inside fruits.
Some plants produce seeds which are very light in weight.
Some seeds are not only light but also have wings.
Some plants produce very heavy seeds which fall to the ground around the plant and start to germinate.
Some plants grow their seeds inside pods.
Some plants growing near water bodies drop their seeds in the water.
